title: Thaddeus at Egress 1

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Hello.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hello.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Not exactly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not exactly.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Who are you talking to?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who are you talking to?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Not physically. This emanation is a hard light holographic transmission of Thaddeus facilitated by a transmission through Egress.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not physically. This emanation is a hard light holographic transmission of Thaddeus facilitated by a transmission through Egress.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: It's true. I'm not really here. Well, as much as I can fail to be somewhere, when I am, most of the time, everywhere.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's true. I'm not really here. Well, as much as I can fail to be somewhere, when I am, most of the time, everywhere.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: I knew you would. You're a keen bean. So you tell me... what's happening?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I knew you would. You're a keen bean. So you tell me... what's happening?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: I think you're starting to figure it out. Why don't you take a guess?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you're starting to figure it out. Why don't you take a guess?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Take a moment. You have all the pieces. Why not try putting them together. Let's start at the beginning. Why did I leave?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Take a moment. You have all the pieces. Why not try putting them together. Let's start at the beginning. Why did I leave?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Good start. You've been paying attention.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good start. You've been paying attention.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Come on, you can do a little better than that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Come on, you can do a little better than that.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Never been, though I hear it's nice. No, I was only bouncing messages off a transmitter there. I'm in the other city: Sang-Ha.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never been, though I hear it's nice. No, I was only bouncing messages off a transmitter there. I'm in the other city: Sang-Ha.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: That's how it felt, but even when I was a temporal traveller, it was only though my own memories. Though admittedly, those go back pretty far. Truth is, all that time travel talk was just half me having fun, half me losing my mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's how it felt, but even when I was a temporal traveller, it was only though my own memories. Though admittedly, those go back pretty far. Truth is, all that time travel talk was just half me having fun, half me losing my mind.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Maybe. Here in Sang-Ha, there's another transmitter. Like Egress. If it still works, I might be able to carry out my experiment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe. Here in Sang-Ha, there's another transmitter. Like Egress. If it still works, I might be able to carry out my experiment.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Did you now? Really? Well, if you're telling the truth, I bet he could barely talk to you through those gritted teeth.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you now? Really? Well, if you're telling the truth, I bet he could barely talk to you through those gritted teeth.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Really? Hmm.... Well I guess it would be pretty hard to get any words out through those gritted teeth. I bet he was sour as lemon juice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really? Hmm.... Well I guess it would be pretty hard to get any words out through those gritted teeth. I bet he was sour as lemon juice.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Quite right Ava. You always kept me on track when my mind began to wander.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Quite right Ava. You always kept me on track when my mind began to wander.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Of course. I see everything she sees, hear everything she hears. Though she was never permitted to tell you that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course. I see everything she sees, hear everything she hears. Though she was never permitted to tell you that.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I did not. Though I suspected I was being manipulated. We both were.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I did not. Though I suspected I was being manipulated. We both were.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I was not aware I was being used in this way. We were both being manipulated.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was not aware I was being used in this way. We were both being manipulated.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Last question. Who am I?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Last question. Who am I?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Haven't you been listening? No, I'm not a time traveller, but... my memories go back very far. I can go back there, if I find the right key to unlock the right doors.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haven't you been listening? No, I'm not a time traveller, but... my memories go back very far. I can go back there, if I find the right key to unlock the right doors.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Is that how much of an influence I've made in this world? A near infinite lifespan, and I'm remembered for the noodles I boiled?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that how much of an influence I've made in this world? A near infinite lifespan, and I'm remembered for the noodles I boiled?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Huh? Well, I confess, I don't understand your reasoning there. But no, I'm not an AI. As far as I know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh? Well, I confess, I don't understand your reasoning there. But no, I'm not an AI. As far as I know.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: I thought I was. But perhaps not anymore. The process that prolongs my life has side effects that no one foresaw.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I thought I was. But perhaps not anymore. The process that prolongs my life has side effects that no one foresaw.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I have been processing everything Thaddeus - or this Thaddeus - has told us. I think I understand now. I have a working theory.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have been processing everything Thaddeus - or this Thaddeus - has told us. I think I understand now. I have a working theory.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: You have more than a theory, Ava. You have the truth. You both do. The only question is, how much of that truth did you uncover? A little, or... everything?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have more than a theory, Ava. You have the truth. You both do. The only question is, how much of that truth did you uncover? A little, or... everything?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Anyway. I'm getting tired. And this transmitter isn't built for long transmission periods any more. Let's give it a rest for a day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anyway. I'm getting tired. And this transmitter isn't built for long transmission periods any more. Let's give it a rest for a day.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: He's gone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's gone.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I guess we will have to find out tomorrow.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess we will have to find out tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thaddeus!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thaddeus!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thaddeus. He is right there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thaddeus. He is right there.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Enough riddles, explain what's going on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Enough riddles, explain what's going on.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Enough riddles, explain what's going on.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Enough riddles, explain what's going on.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have figured out what's happening.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have figured out what's happening.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have figured out what's happening.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have figured out what's happening.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You were going on a trip.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You were going on a trip.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You were going on a trip.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You were going on a trip.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your mind is failing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your mind is failing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're dying.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're dying.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And...

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Where do you think I am now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where do you think I am now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Luna.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Luna.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You've travelled back in time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You've travelled back in time.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're in another city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're in another city.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Good job detective. I'm in the other city: Sang-Ha. They call it the big sister. Softer than Nivalis, and bigger too, but no less chaotic. And equally doomed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good job detective. I'm in the other city: Sang-Ha. They call it the big sister. Softer than Nivalis, and bigger too, but no less chaotic. And equally doomed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you coming back?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you coming back?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Which is?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Which is?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Never been fond of the idea of death. Don't fancy it at all. I was thinking maybe I won't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never been fond of the idea of death. Don't fancy it at all. I was thinking maybe I won't.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Die?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Die?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Yes. I'd really rather not. Tell me, did you talk with old Alan Fontus? I bet he was pissed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. I'd really rather not. Tell me, did you talk with old Alan Fontus? I bet he was pissed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I talked with him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I talked with him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I didn't talk to him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't talk to him.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I think his time is limited.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think his time is limited.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You can hear her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You can hear her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You betrayed me. I knew it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You betrayed me. I knew it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You betrayed me. I knew it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You betrayed me. I knew it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did you know you were a spy?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you know you were a spy?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Did you know you were a spy?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Did you know you were a spy?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're a noodle maker.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're a noodle maker.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're a time traveller.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're a time traveller.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're an AI.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're an AI.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're eternal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're eternal.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What does he mean: "A little, or everything?"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What does he mean: "A little, or everything?"
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What does he mean: "A little, or everything?"
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What does he mean: "A little, or everything?"
